title: What They Never Taught You: Real Talk about Your Creative Career
overview: Yuko Shimizu shares insights from her journey transitioning from art school to a successful freelance illustration career, emphasizing the business side of creativity that is often overlooked. She covers portfolio development, handling rejection, working with clients, and maintaining a unique artistic voice in the era of AI tools. Throughout, she offers practical advice for emerging artists on building resilience, negotiating work, and leveraging personal projects for growth.
